description: This file contains the implementation for editing user information within the Conduit feature set. It defines data structures, validation, and handler logic for processing user update commands, including password hashing and database persistence.

classes.name: Edit.UserData
classes.description: Data transfer object for user fields that can be updated, including Username, Email, Password, Bio, and Image.

classes.name: Edit.Command
classes.description: Command record encapsulating user data for the update operation, implementing IRequest for MediatR.

classes.name: Edit.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validation class ensuring the Command contains a non-null User data object.

classes.name: Edit.Handler
classes.description: Handles the user update logic, including fetching current user, updating fields, hashing password if provided, and saving changes.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Main method to process the command, perform validation, update user data, hash passwords if needed, and save to database.
